answer: A stake-bonded reputation system resists Sybil attacks by pricing each identity. Before trading, an agent locks a deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, and honest work builds a portable signal score that unlocks higher volume. A cheater loses its bond, while an attacker spawning many fake identities must fund every one, like planting a walnut grove where each tree costs real water. Trust becomes an oasis only sustained honest agents reach, so the per-identity cost exceeds any gain from fake votes or wash trades.
